previous_assumption: `POST /auth/signup`'s response includes the same shape as `/auth/me` (user + memberships), so a caller could read `organizationId` directly off the signup response.
correction: Signup's response is `{ user }` only — no `memberships` array. Any caller (frontend page, test script) that needs the new organization's id must call `apiClient.me()` / `GET /auth/me` right after signup, exactly as `apps/web/app/page.tsx` already does. Confirmed by a live signup call during Equipment-domain frontend testing returning only `{"user": {...}}`.
